description: This file defines Express.js route handlers related to tenant-scoped operations on the 'llm_costs' collection in a MongoDB database. It includes endpoints for retrieving and inserting tenant-specific records, utilizing middleware for authentication and tenant verification.

methods.name: GET /api/sample/records
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve tenant-specific 'llm_costs' records with optional filtering, enforcing tenant scope.

methods.name: POST /api/sample/records
methods.description: Handles POST requests to insert a new record into the 'llm_costs' collection, enforcing tenant restrictions on the payload.
